# Data Model: Enhanced Agent Metrics System

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55 | Date: 2026-01-26 -->

**Feature**: 001-agent-metrics-enhancement
**Date**: 2026-01-26
**Status**: Design Complete

---

## Entity Overview

| Entity | Description | Storage |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| **Session** | A collection of invocations for one Spec-Kit phase run | `agent-metrics.json` |
| **Invocation** | A single agent execution with full metadata | Embedded in Session |
| **Archive** | A preserved session with timestamp for historical analysis | `archive/*.json` |
| **Settings** | Configuration for retention, costs, display | `settings.json` |

---

## 1. Session Entity

Root object stored in `agent-metrics.json`.

### Schema

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "2.0.0",
  "phase": "implement",
  "featureBranch": "001-agent-metrics-enhancement",
  "startTime": "2026-01-26T10:00:00.000Z",
  "endTime": null,
  "completionStatus": "active",
  "sessionId": "a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55",

  "invocations": [],
  "agents": {},
  "models": {},
  "categories": {},
  "parallelGroups": {},
  "totals": {}
}
```

### Field Definitions

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `schemaVersion` | string | Yes | Schema version for compatibility checking |
| `phase` | string | Yes | Spec-Kit phase: specify, clarify, plan, tasks, checklist, analyze, implement |
| `featureBranch` | string | Yes | Git branch name (FR-014) |
| `startTime` | ISO8601 | Yes | Session start timestamp |
| `endTime` | ISO8601 | No | Session end timestamp (set on Report) |
| `completionStatus` | enum | Yes | `active`, `complete`, `incomplete` (FR-010) |
| `sessionId` | string | No | Claude session ID for correlation |
| `invocations` | array | Yes | List of Invocation objects |
| `agents` | object | Yes | Aggregated metrics per agent |
| `models` | object | Yes | Aggregated metrics per model (NEW for FR-001) |
| `categories` | object | Yes | Aggregated metrics per task category (NEW for FR-007) |
| `parallelGroups` | object | Yes | Parallel execution groups (NEW for FR-009) |
| `totals` | object | Yes | Session-level totals |

## 2. Invocation Entity

Individual agent execution record.

### Schema

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-01-26T10:05:30.123Z",
  "agent": "backend-developer",
  "model": "sonnet",
  "taskId": "a620108",
  "status": "completed",
  "tokens": 45000,
  "durationMs": 120000,
  "description": "Implement PaywallController",

  "phase": "implement",
  "category": "implementation",

  "invocationStartTime": "2026-01-26T10:03:30.123Z",
  "invocationEndTime": "2026-01-26T10:05:30.123Z",

  "isParallel": true,
  "parallelGroupId": "pg-20260126-100300",
  "groupSize": 3
}
```

### Field Definitions

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `timestamp` | ISO8601 | Yes | Current time | Record timestamp |
| `agent` | string | Yes | - | Agent name (e.g., "backend-developer") |
| `model` | string | Yes | - | AI model: "opus", "sonnet", "haiku" (FR-001) |
| `taskId` | string | Yes | - | Task identifier from agent response |
| `status` | enum | Yes | - | "completed", "failed", "timeout" |
| `tokens` | integer | Yes | 0 | Total tokens used |
| `durationMs` | integer | Yes | 0 | Duration in milliseconds |
| `description` | string | No | "" | Task description |
| `phase` | string | Yes | - | Spec-Kit phase name (FR-013) |
| `category` | string | No | "other" | Task category (FR-007) |
| `invocationStartTime` | ISO8601 | No | calculated | When agent started (FR-009) |
| `invocationEndTime` | ISO8601 | No | timestamp | When agent completed (FR-009) |
| `isParallel` | boolean | No | false | Was `&` operator used (FR-009) |
| `parallelGroupId` | string | No | null | Group ID for parallel invocations (FR-009) |
| `groupSize` | integer | No | 1 | Expected concurrent count (FR-009) |

### Valid Values

#### status
- `completed` - Agent finished successfully
- `failed` - Agent encountered an error
- `timeout` - Agent exceeded time limit

#### model
- `opus` - Claude Opus (cost weight: 5.0)
- `sonnet` - Claude Sonnet (cost weight: 3.0)
- `haiku` - Claude Haiku (cost weight: 1.0)

#### phase
- `specify` - /speckit.specify
- `clarify` - /speckit.clarify
- `plan` - /speckit.plan
- `tasks` - /speckit.tasks
- `checklist` - /speckit.checklist
- `analyze` - /speckit.analyze
- `implement` - /speckit.implement

#### category
- `implementation` - Writing production code
- `testing` - Writing or running tests
- `review` - Code review activities
- `planning` - Architecture and planning
- `analysis` - Code analysis and exploration
- `other` - Uncategorized tasks

## 3. Settings Entity

Configuration stored in `settings.json`.

### Schema

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "retention": {
    "archiveDays": 7,
    "autoCleanupEnabled": true
  },
  "costWeights": {
    "haiku": 1.0,
    "sonnet": 3.0,
    "opus": 5.0
  },
  "display": {
    "colorOutput": true,
    "showCostEstimates": true,
    "showParallelMetrics": true
  }
}
```

### Field Definitions

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `schemaVersion` | string | "1.0.0" | Settings schema version |
| `retention.archiveDays` | integer | 7 | Days to retain archives (FR-019) |
| `retention.autoCleanupEnabled` | boolean | true | Auto-purge old archives (FR-020) |
| `costWeights.haiku` | number | 1.0 | Haiku cost multiplier |
| `costWeights.sonnet` | number | 3.0 | Sonnet cost multiplier |
| `costWeights.opus` | number | 5.0 | Opus cost multiplier |
| `display.colorOutput` | boolean | true | Use colored console output |
| `display.showCostEstimates` | boolean | true | Show cost distribution |
| `display.showParallelMetrics` | boolean | true | Show parallelization section |

## 4. ParallelGroup Entity

Aggregated parallel execution metrics (embedded in Session).

### Schema

```json
{
  "pg-20260126-100300": {
    "groupId": "pg-20260126-100300",
    "phase": "implement",
    "declaredParallel": true,
    "groupStartTime": "2026-01-26T10:03:00.000Z",
    "groupEndTime": "2026-01-26T10:05:30.123Z",
    "groupDurationMs": 150123,

    "invocationCount": 3,
    "taskIds": ["a620108", "a620109", "a620110"],

    "concurrencyMetrics": {
      "maxConcurrent": 3,
      "avgConcurrent": 2.5,
      "sequentialEquivalentMs": 335000,
      "actualDurationMs": 150123,
      "timeReduction": 55.2,
      "efficiency": 100.0
    }
  }
}
```

### Field Definitions

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `groupId` | string | Unique identifier for the parallel group |
| `phase` | string | Spec-Kit phase |
| `declaredParallel` | boolean | Was this group declared with `&` operator |
| `groupStartTime` | ISO8601 | Earliest invocation start time |
| `groupEndTime` | ISO8601 | Latest invocation end time |
| `groupDurationMs` | integer | Total elapsed time for the group |
| `invocationCount` | integer | Number of invocations in group |
| `taskIds` | array | List of task IDs in the group |
| `concurrencyMetrics.maxConcurrent` | integer | Peak simultaneous agents |
| `concurrencyMetrics.efficiency` | number | maxConcurrent / declaredSize × 100 |

## 6. Schema Migration

### Version History

| Version | Date | Changes |
|---------|------|---------|
| 1.0.0 | 2026-01-20 | Initial schema (existing) |
| 2.0.0 | 2026-01-26 | Add model, category, phase, parallel fields |

### Migration Strategy (FR-018)

Per spec requirement FR-018: **No migration of legacy data**. The system will:

1. Check `schemaVersion` on load
2. If missing or < 2.0.0, treat file as legacy
3. Legacy files are ignored for trend analysis
4. Reset action will archive legacy files normally
5. New sessions always use schemaVersion 2.0.0

---

## 7. File Organization

```text
.specify/metrics/
├── agent-metrics.json           # Active session (v2.0.0 schema)
├── agent-metrics-report.json    # Last generated report
├── settings.json                # Configuration
└── archive/
    ├── agent-metrics-20260125-153045.json   # Archived sessions
    ├── agent-metrics-20260124-091230.json
    └── agent-metrics-20260123-141500.json
```

### Naming Conventions

- Active file: `agent-metrics.json`
- Report file: `agent-metrics-report.json`
- Archive pattern: `agent-metrics-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.json`
- Settings: `settings.json`

---

## 8. Validation Rules

### Session Validation

| Rule | Severity | Description |
|------|----------|-------------|
| `phase` must be valid enum | ERROR | One of 7 Spec-Kit phases |
| `startTime` must be valid ISO8601 | ERROR | Parseable timestamp |
| `completionStatus` must be valid enum | ERROR | active, complete, incomplete |
| `invocations` must be array | ERROR | Even if empty |

### Invocation Validation

| Rule | Severity | Description |
|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent` must not be empty | ERROR | Required field |
| `model` must be opus/sonnet/haiku | ERROR | Valid model identifier |
| `status` must be valid enum | ERROR | completed/failed/timeout |
| `tokens` must be >= 0 | WARNING | 0 if unavailable |
| `durationMs` must be > 0 | WARNING | Should always be positive |

### Edge Case Handling (FR-010)

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Missing token count | Record as 0, log warning |
| Invalid model name | Default to agent's configured model |
| Missing phase | Default to "unknown" |
| Incomplete session | Mark as "incomplete" on next Init |
